instrument: National Vocational Education and Training Regulator (Compliance Standards for NVR Registered Training Organisations and Fit and Proper Person Requirements) Instrument 2025
_comment: Clause numbers and Division headings verified against the instrument text on 2026-09-04. The 'requires' text is a working summary, not a quotation. Quote the instrument itself before putting a requirement in a policy.

requirements.heading: Marketing and advertising
requirements.requires: Advertisements carry the registration code, represent services accurately, state financial support arrangements accurately, and claim no unauthorised connection with another entity. Marketing that names a training product uses the National Register code and title, covers only products on scope, and limits references to discontinued products.
hardEdges: National Register code and title, verbatim
no product advertised that is not on scope

requirements.heading: Guarantees and inducements
requirements.requires: No guarantee of successful completion, of a non-compliant delivery method, or of an employment outcome the organisation does not control.

requirements.division: Integrity of nationally recognised training products
requirements.heading: Issuance of AQF certification documentation
requirements.requires: Certification is issued only to a student assessed as meeting the requirements, within 30 calendar days of the assessment being completed, where the student has completed the requirements and paid the agreed fees.
hardEdges: 30 calendar days from completion of assessment
requirements.indicator: median and 90th-percentile days from final assessment to certificate issue

requirements.division: Integrity of nationally recognised training products
requirements.heading: Records of AQF certification documentation and assessments
requirements.requires: A register complying with the AQF Qualifications Register Policy; certification documentation retained 30 years; assessment records retained 2 years after completion; students able to obtain copies; issue reports provided to the Regulator on request.
requirements.indicator: oldest assessment record still held, against the 2-year floor

requirements.division: Integrity of nationally recognised training products
requirements.heading: Issue of VET qualifications and statements of attainment
requirements.requires: Prescribed content on every testamur and statement of attainment: organisation name, registration code and logo, product code and title, NRT logo, authorised signature, security feature, AQF recognition statement, industry descriptor and stream where applicable, apprenticeship notation where applicable, and the language-of-delivery declaration.
hardEdges: every prescribed field present on the printed document

requirements.division: Integrity of nationally recognised training products
requirements.heading: Student identifier requirements
requirements.requires: No student identifier printed on a qualification or statement of attainment; identifier ownership verified before use; no credential issued without an assigned identifier, subject to ministerial exemption. A non-constitutional corporation informs students of the consequences of an exemption before enrolment is complete.
hardEdges: USI never printed on the testamur

requirements.division: Integrity of nationally recognised training products
requirements.heading: Nationally Recognised Training logo
requirements.requires: The NRT logo is used only as the NRT Logo Conditions of Use Policy (Schedule 2) permits.
hardEdges: not on corporate stationery, business cards, buildings, training resources or merchandise
PMS 343 green and PMS 192 red only

requirements.division: Integrity of nationally recognised training products
requirements.heading: Transition of training products
requirements.requires: No new enrolment in a superseded product more than one year after supersession. Students in a product that is no longer current complete or transfer within the prescribed period: two years for a qualification, one year for other products.
requirements.indicator: days remaining on the transition clock for every superseded product with a live enrolment

requirements.heading: Annual declaration on compliance
requirements.requires: An annual declaration on compliance is submitted for each registration period, in the approved form published by the National VET Regulator.

requirements.heading: Notification of material changes
requirements.requires: Significant events affecting compliance are notified within 10 business days. Prospective changes of ownership are notified as soon as practicable. Changes of governing persons are notified within 10 business days or as soon as practicable.
requirements.indicator: days from event to notification, every notifiable event in the period

requirements.heading: Third party arrangements
requirements.requires: A written agreement for every third party delivering services, requiring cooperation with the Regulator and accurate information, prohibiting the third party from using the NRT logo or issuing AQF certification documentation, and containing the prescribed particulars including business names, dates, obligations and monitoring entitlements. Commencement and conclusion are notified within 30 calendar days.
hardEdges: 30 calendar days to notify start and end
requirements.indicator: third-party arrangements live in the SMS with no corresponding notification

requirements.heading: Prepaid fee protection
requirements.requires: Where prepaid fees exceed $1,500 per course: a government entity or university maintains a policy assuring an equivalent placement or a refund; any other organisation holds a financial guarantee, tuition assurance scheme membership, or an alternative approved by the Regulator.

requirements.heading: Public liability insurance
requirements.requires: Public liability insurance covering all operations is maintained throughout the registration period.

requirements.heading: Compliance with laws
requirements.requires: Compliance with Commonwealth, State and Territory law, in particular the handling of personal information and the Student Identifiers Act 2014.

requirements.heading: Fit and Proper Person Requirements
requirements.requires: The Regulator may consider, for the organisation, each governing person and each applicant: compliance with the law; management history including cancelled, suspended or rejected registrations and involvement with entities subject to regulatory action; financial record including insolvency and Commonwealth debts; provision of false or misleading information; previous conduct and fit-and-proper determinations under other education law; and whether public confidence in the person's involvement is likely.
hardEdges: a current declaration on file for every governing person
re-declared when a governing person changes
requirements.note: Read with CS-16: a change of governing person is a notifiable event within 10 business days.

requirements.heading: NRT Logo Conditions of Use Policy
requirements.requires: The NRT logo appears on all AQF certification documentation and on no other testamur or transcript; may be used in advertising for nationally recognised training within scope without implying it covers all training; must not appear on corporate stationery, business cards, buildings, training resources or merchandise; reproduced only from the supplied artwork, in PMS 343 green and PMS 192 red, or one colour, never mirrored or rotated.
